subject.title: claude-cli auth failure shows generic error instead of re-auth hint when OAuth token is expired

question: Which open candidate PR should be treated as the canonical fix for the Claude CLI expired-token re-auth hint?
rationale: Current main still misses the reported Claude CLI OAuth 401 shape, and multiple open closing PRs overlap the same fix; selecting the canonical branch and recovery-command wording needs maintainer review rather than another automated repair job.

options.title: Review the most proven candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97669 as the first canonical candidate because it includes real Claude CLI 401 proof and structured FailoverError handling.

options.title: Compare the other open candidates
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97894 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98036 against the same source path before choosing a branch.

options.title: Reject the specific hint
options.body: Close or redirect the candidate PRs only if maintainers decide the current generic provider-auth copy is intentionally sufficient for Claude CLI OAuth expiry.

recommendation.title: Review the most proven candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97669 as the first canonical candidate because it includes real Claude CLI 401 proof and structured FailoverError handling.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the fresh live assignee for this issue and is therefore the best current decision owner for the competing fix PRs.
